title: KoszulOpenHomChainEvaluation
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, f a finite sequence, U its principal-open union [def-sc-koszul-open-system], R derived restriction followed by the over-category equivalence, H=H^0 on D(A), and G=derived affineOpenSections(U) [def-sc-koszul-cech-comparison-construction]. Derived categories are as in [def-pc-derived-category]. There are equivalences b_E:Hom(R(O),R(E)) to H(G(E)) for every derived sheaf object E, natural under postcomposition by every derived arrow. For every termwise quasi-coherent complex F, stage e, and sheaf chain map t:tilde I_e to F, if R(unit_e) composed with psi equals R(Q(t)), then b_Q(F)(psi) equals H(koszulCechDerivedComparison(F)) applied to H(Q(colimit.ι D e)) of the explicit stage class of t constructed in [lem-sc-koszul-open-hom-chain-representatives]. No stage Hom equivalences or reduction of arbitrary derived arrows to chain maps is asserted.

source.place: Proposition 36.9.5, chain comparison with equation 36.9.4.1; Tags 08D1 and 09M1

proof.text: Identify the extended tilde of A[0] with the degree-zero structure sheaf, and its derived restriction with O_U[0]. Apply the natural structure-sheaf Hom/hypercohomology identification on U. Restrict scalars from Gamma(U,O_U) to A, using the composition iso for derived sections and the homology/restriction-of-scalars comparison. This constructs equivalences b for all E in D(O_Spec A), natural in postcomposition.

For the chain map t, the affine adjunction transpose gives its module Hom cocycle. On a principal intersection indexed by J, the explicit cocone evaluates on the ordered exterior generator, divides by (product f_j)^(e+1), and multiplies by (-1)^(pq+p(p-1)/2), with p=card(J)-1 and q=-p. The wedge contraction by the j-th generator divided by f_j^(e+1) on D(f_j) makes the restricted tail augmentation invertible. Iterating contractions on intersections yields precisely these fractions and totalization signs. Thus t composed with the inverse augmentation has the same Cech class as the cocone image of koszulOpenHomStageClass(t). Apply the Cech-to-derived-sections comparison and H^0. The hypothesis on psi identifies it with that inverse-augmentation composite. Homotopies change only boundaries; empty covers, the zero ring and F=0 give zero classes.

theorem koszulOpenHom_chain_evaluation
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : (Spec (.of A)).Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace).over V))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (koszulOpen A r f).toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{v} (ModuleCat.{u} A)] :
    let R := ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace) (koszulOpen A r f)) ⋙
      Equivalence.functor
        (C := SheafOfModules.{u}
          ((moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace).over (koszulOpen A r f)))
        (D := SheafOfModules.{u}
          (moduleRings (koszulOpen A r f).toScheme.toRingedSpace))
        (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (koszulOpen A r f))).mapDerivedCategory
    let H := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0
    let G := (affineOpenSections A (koszulOpen A r f)).rightDerivedFunctor
    ∃ b : ∀ E : schemeDerivedCategory (Spec (.of A)),
      (R.obj (koszulOpenStructure A) ⟶ R.obj E) ≃ H.obj (G.obj E),
      (∀ (E E' : schemeDerivedCategory (Spec (.of A))) (g : E ⟶ E')
        (ψ : R.obj (koszulOpenStructure A) ⟶ R.obj E),
        b E' (ψ ≫ R.map g) = H.map (G.map g) (b E ψ)) ∧
      ∀ (F : CochainComplex
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
        (_hF : ∀ n : ℤ, (F.X n).IsQuasicoherent)
        (e : ℕ) (t : koszulOpenSheafComplex A r f e ⟶ F)
        (ψ : R.obj (koszulOpenStructure A) ⟶ R.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj F)),
        R.map (koszulOpenUnit A r f e) ≫ ψ = R.map (DerivedCategory.Q.map t) →
        b (DerivedCategory.Q.obj F) ψ =
          H.map (koszulCechDerivedComparison A r f F)
            (H.map (DerivedCategory.Q.map (colimit.ι
              (koszulCechHomDiagram A r f
                (((affineOpenSections A ⊤).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj F)) e))
                  (koszulOpenHomStageClass A r f F e t))
